title.orig: 酬樂天揚州初逢席上見贈
title.en: Reply to Letian, Who Gave Me a Poem When We First Met at a Feast in Yangzhou
title.zh: 酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 842.

note.en: In 826 Liu Yuxi, back from more than twenty years of exile in the south, met Bai Juyi at Yangzhou; Bai wrote a poem lamenting how badly Liu had been treated, and this is Liu's reply. It answers pity with its third couplet: beside a sunken boat a thousand sails go by, in front of a sick tree ten thousand trees come into spring. The 'flute' poem is Xiang Xiu's lament for lost friends, and the woodcutter watched a game of chess in the mountains and came home to find a lifetime gone.
note.zh: 826 年，刘禹锡结束二十多年的南方贬谪，与白居易在扬州相遇；白居易作诗为他的遭遇不平，这首是刘禹锡的答诗。它用第三联回应同情：沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春。“闻笛赋”指向秀追念亡友的《思旧赋》；“烂柯人”是山中观棋的樵夫，回家时已过了一辈子。

excerpt.orig: 沉舟側畔千帆過，病樹前頭萬木春。
excerpt.en: Beside the sunken boat a thousand sails go by; / in front of the sick tree ten thousand trees are in spring.
excerpt.zh: 沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春。
